name: Controls — expected quiet
description: Intact, remote, protected forest cores where nothing should fire. Every finding here is counted as a false positive for the rule that produced it: this is how the ledger measures its own error rate honestly. Thresholds tuned 2026-09-26 after the first live sweep: at minHa 5 both cores fired on ~15–19 ha / 90 d of high-confidence alerts (1571 alerts in Jaú — radar alerts on seasonal floodplain water, not clearing), so the floor sits above that noise with margin; NDVI confirmation never fired for either.
